heading: Emami share price jumps 4% ahead of buyback: What should investors do? Check stop loss, target
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Emami's buyback plan targets  ₹475 per share, with a maximum buyback size of  ₹282 crore. Existing shareholding may shift, increasing promoter ownership to 55.6%. Analysts suggest accumulating shares in the  ₹360-380 range, while key support stands at  ₹340.
